text:
iona: Heads-up — candidate Jordan K (SRE IC3) next Wed needs a slight shift: organizer moved from 9:00am PT to 10:00am PT because of timezone overlap. Can folks confirm availability? We also need a scribe + debrief lead, and to confirm recording consent from the candidate.

matt: I can do the debrief lead. @lina fyi.

david_k: I can cover 10:00–10:45 and take scribe if nobody else volunteers.

lina: thanks — prefer matt as debrief lead. For rubric, are we using the long-form system rubric or the compact one?

iona: quick question on rubric too — want to know whether to use "compact-quick" or "systematic-v2" for scoring anchors. Need to set weights in the doc.

lina: use compact-quick v1.3 for this role. Weighting: technical 70%, communication 20%, ownership 10%. If the candidate doesn't reach system-design, mark "needs more data" rather than forcing a low score.

david_k: got it. I'll capture scores in the shared debrief doc and tag relevant anchors.

iona: calendar-bot updated event time. Also, candidate asked about recording — did we capture explicit consent earlier?

matt: I don't recall consent being recorded. We'll ask at the top of the loop and respect the answer.

calendar-bot: Event updated — "Jordan K interview" moved to 2026-05-13T10:00:00-07:00.

iona: I'll ping the candidate now to request permission to record for internal notes. If they decline we'll not record and note it. Added a short paragraph to the interview doc template: "Please ask candidate for permission to record the session for internal review. If declined, do not record and note in debrief."

david_k: Sharing the candidate sandbox and interview kit links so folks can prep: https://internal.coding-sandboxes/redwood/jordan-k (access set) and https://docs.redwood/intrv/kits/compact-quick-v1.3

david_k: Quick env snippet if you want to pre-load the sandbox:
```bash
ssh -i ~/.ssh/redwood_id deploy@sandbox
tmux new -s jordan-k
```

iona: thanks. Also candidate asked for timezone-friendly feedback — can we commit to 72 hours for sending final feedback?

matt: yes 72h works. I'll own final feedback send. @lina if anything needs escalation please flag before I send.

lina: will do. Thanks all :thumbsup:

david_k: LGTM. See you Wed.

calendar-bot: Recording permission request sent to candidate.
